reader_summary.overview: Today's show is the most popular episode from our new podcast, Investment Management Operations. Host Scott McDonald interviews Jenn Birmingham. In particular, her descriptions of collaboration and decision-making at PRINCO offer an insider's look at one of the top endowment performers for decades.

key_points.text: Host Scott McDonald interviews Jenn Birmingham.
Jenn often refers to the leadership of Andy Golden, PRINCO's longtime CIO.
His first appearance on Capital Allocators is replayed in the feed.
